basic_details.job_title: DHS Cuddalore Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 89 Posts
basic_details.application_mode: Offline – in person or by Speed Post
basic_details.job_location: Emergency obstetric and newborn care centres, Cuddalore district, Tamil Nadu
basic_details.short_information: This recruitment fills temporary contract Staff Nurse posts in the comprehensive emergency obstetric and newborn care centres in Cuddalore district that are under the control of the Director of Medical and Rural Health Services and the Director of Medical Education and Research. The engagement is made through the District Health Society. The official notification does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

age_limit.details: The age limit for the NHM Cuddalore Staff Nurse post is up to 50 years. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for calculating age or any age relaxation.

qualification.education_qualification: GNM or B.Sc. Nursing, with Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration
qualification.details: Other conditions printed in the notice and its document list: | Evidence of Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard marks) must be attached. Proof of residency must be attached: Nativity Certificate issued by the Revenue Department, Voter ID, Panchayat / Municipality / Corporation tax receipt, Aadhar Card or Ration Card (any one). Differently abled candidates must attach a certificate from a Block Medical Officer stating fitness to discharge the duties assigned, with the percentage of disability. A No Objection Certificate from the competent authority is required if applicable. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the Staff Nurse post.

salary_details.details: The notice does not mention any allowances on top of the monthly salary.

how_to_apply: Use the application form for Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse attached to the notice as Annexure-II (National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu).

Fill in the form: District Health Society, district, name, father's name, date of birth, age, gender, qualification (GNM / B.Sc. Nursing), institution, Nursing Council registration number, addresses, Aadhar number, phone, email (if available) and community (SC / ST / BC / MBC / OC).

Give your 10th (SSLC) and HSC (+2) marks, the percentage in the qualifying exam (GNM / B.Sc.), the district(s) applied for, and whether you are differently abled, transgender, a deserted wife, an ex-serviceman or a destitute widow.
Paste a passport size photograph, then sign and date the declaration that the post is purely temporary on a contractual basis and will not be regularised.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below.
Submit the completed application to: Executive Secretary/District Health Officer, District Health Society, District Health Office, 05 Beach Road, Cuddalore-607001.
Submit it in person or by Speed Post between 21 November 2026, 10.00 AM and 4 December 2026, 5.00 PM; late applications will not be accepted.
Two recent passport size colour photographs
Evidence of date of birth (Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate)
Evidence of educational qualification and marks (SSLC / HSC / Diploma / B.Sc. Degree – provisional or degree certificate and mark sheets)
Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate
Evidence for Tamil eligibility (10th or 12th standard marks)
Proof of residency (any one of the documents listed under eligibility)
Certificate of character and conduct issued by a Group A or Group B officer working in Government, issued within 3 months prior to the notification
Certificate of character and conduct from the head of the institution where the candidate studied or is studying
Disability certificate from a Block Medical Officer (differently abled candidates)
Certified evidence of work experience (if any)
No Objection Certificate from the competent authority (if applicable)
Community Certificate
Any other special records from competent authorities as indicated in the selection criteria
important_instructions: The post is purely temporary, on contract basis. The service will not be made permanent at any time, and the appointee may be relieved from service at any time. Appointees have no right to claim regularisation. Selected candidates will be appointed as per G.O. No. 427, Health and Family Welfare Department, dated 18.11.2026. For further information, applicants may refer to the NHM-TN website (https://nhm.tn.gov.in), the respective District Health Society / Office of the District Health Officer / City Health Officer, GCC, or the respective District Collectorate website.

content_sections.heading: About NHM Cuddalore Staff Nurse
content_sections.text: The District Health Society, Cuddalore functions under the National Health Mission – Tamil Nadu from the District Health Office, 05 Beach Road, Cuddalore-607001. It is headed by the District Collector as Chairman, with the District Health Officer as Executive Secretary, and both have signed this notice.
